name: Drei Tannen
beschreibung:
Centrally and sunnily situated in scenic Tannheim, Haus Drei Tannen welcomes guests with a warm atmosphere and splendid views of the Tannheimer mountains. The tastefully furnished apartments provide all modern comforts for a relaxing holiday.

In summer, gentle valley paths, rugged peaks, and idyllic Lake Vilsalpsee await, while winter brings award-winning cross-country trails and family-friendly ski slopes right to the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Drei Tannen in Tannheim offers cosy holiday apartments in what is hailed as Europe's most beautiful high valley.
